subject.title: PR #92231 fix incomplete — commitment marked 'sent' but never delivered (second case)

question: Is the existing issue record enough to prioritize a live maintainer repro of the second false-sent path, or should this wait for fresh Telegram/database/event evidence?
rationale: Source inspection proves false-sent records remain terminal, but the exact current-main path that marks a commitment sent without visible delivery is not isolated, so automation cannot choose a safe repair boundary.

options.title: Keep live-repro owner path
options.body: Keep this issue open with maintainer review and ask for or run live Telegram, DB, and heartbeat-event proof before selecting a fix.

options.title: Fold into an adjacent PR only after proof
options.body: Link this issue to a narrower open commitment-delivery PR only if that PR proves it fixes this exact false-sent recurrence.

options.title: Defer without repair
options.body: Leave the stale label but avoid fix-PR automation until a concrete current-main reproduction or maintainer proof waiver appears.

recommendation.title: Keep live-repro owner path
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open with maintainer review and ask for or run live Telegram, DB, and heartbeat-event proof before selecting a fix.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the recent suppressed-send fix this issue names as incomplete, making them the best routing candidate for comparing the first fix against this second case.
